summary: the service log suite, on a root whose init-shell is built with each fault in init.c

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 utils check-busybox build/tests/system/harness build/tests/system/runutil build/tools/image/mkmbr && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} utils/sbin/init-shell

rm -rf "$1/servicelog"; exec sh tests/system/suites/servicelog.sh "$ARCH_BUILD/rach2/kernel" build/tests/system/harness build/tools/image/mkmbr "$1/init-shell" "$ARCH_BUILD/utils/update" "$ARCH_BUILD/vendor/busybox/busybox" "$1/servicelog"

faults.name: bound-removed
faults.summary: the emptying of the log within a boot taken out, so the first boot fails

lines: servicelog-test: FAIL: the log was not emptied within the boot

faults.name: removal-removed
faults.summary: the removal at boot of a log the boot before left full taken out, so the second boot fails

lines: servicelog-test: FAIL: the log the boot before left full was not removed
